title: Chimi Bees
body:
Why can't we get honey and wax when we harvest a beehive?

Chimi Bees allows us to do so! Use the new Honey Extractor to get Honey and Wax from honey combs!

The Wax fulfils honey combs utilities!

The Honey Extractor can also be used as working station for Beekeepers, a new villager profession!
